tests.wlc_control: Actual namespaced OSIS verse read; יֵצֵא, future context, all women; consonants יצא.
tests.alpha_reading: καὶ εἰς πάντας τοὺς λαοὺς ἡ ἀδικία αὐτῆς ἐξῆλθεν
tests.alpha_apparatus: No variant reported at ἐξῆλθεν; surrounding 16 αυτης dh, αυτη m.
tests.swete_control: Printed758/PDF776 main1:17 has report/speech construction; small apparatus varies that construction, no Alpha diagnostic verb reported.
tests.argument: Fox45 explains past verb through alternative vocalization of same Hebrew consonants; himself accepts MT pointing as contextually correct.
tests.judgment: Potential Hebrew contact does not distinguish independent translation from Hebrew-aware revision; no different consonants at target verb and no POB tense change.

tests.wlc_control: Actual namespaced OSIS verse read; fostering אֹמֵן, both beauty clauses, orphan/adoption wording.
tests.alpha_apparatus: No variant reported at diagnostic expression; later beauty clause has 7 ειδη m.
tests.swete_control: Printed759/PDF777 main lacks Alpha fostering opening; has wife interpretation. Apparatus after εἴδει adds καὶ ὡραῖον τῇ ὄψει σφόδρα in Sinaiticus corrector margin, marked mg; lower-margin mg inf belongs to the separate2:8 entry. Different morphology/order from Alpha καὶ ὡραία τῇ ὄψει.
tests.argument: Fox45–46 links faithfulness sense to Hebrew אמן and acknowledges Greek recensional beauty parallels.
tests.judgment: More informative than generic style; still allows Greek elaboration or selective Hebrew-aware revision. Beauty phrase not unique Alpha contact. Do not add faithfully to Hebrew-based English or reconstruct an extra Hebrew word.

hypotheses: Simple copying of the selected Old Greek text is inadequate to describe the differences.
Greek rewriting informed by Hebrew or another rendering remains viable at these two units.
Independent Hebrew translation plus later Greek supplementation is Fox's argued explanation, not an extant recovered Hebrew text or established earliest stage.
